Nautilus.adc_interaction_notes: Premier engage support. Hook + passive root guarantee kills in lane. Heavy CC peel in teamfights. Jinx/Kai'Sa/Aphelios thrive with Nautilus.

Leona.adc_interaction_notes: Hardest engage support. Chains CC locks down targets for your ADC to free-hit. Best with burst ADCs (MF, Samira, Draven) who capitalize on locked targets.

Thresh.adc_interaction_notes: Swiss army knife support. Hook for picks, flay for peel, lantern for saves. Works with every ADC. Kalista/Kai'Sa benefit most from his versatility.

Blitzcrank.adc_interaction_notes: One hook wins lane. Creates kill threat from range. Best with burst ADCs who need one target delivered. Less reliable peel than other engage supports.

Rakan.adc_interaction_notes: Fastest engage in the game. Xayah synergy is unique (shared recall, feather interaction). Provides both engage and disengage. Good with any ADC that can follow up.

Rell.adc_interaction_notes: AOE engage with W + R. Gravitational pull groups enemies for AOE ADCs (MF, Jinx, Aphelios). Tankier than most engage supports. Slow dismount is a weakness.

Alistar.adc_interaction_notes: WQ combo is reliable engage. R makes him almost unkillable. Excellent at peeling divers off ADC. Samira and Kalista love the all-in potential.

Lulu.adc_interaction_notes: The ultimate ADC-empowering support. W attack speed steroid, E shield, R knockup + health. Turns any hypercarry into a raid boss. KogMaw/Jinx/Twitch are her best partners.

Janna.adc_interaction_notes: Best peeler in the game. Tornado and R disengage protect ADC from any dive. Shield provides AD steroid. Perfect for immobile hypercarries who need to be untouched.

Nami.adc_interaction_notes: Strong lane trading with W bounce and E auto-enhance. Lucian + Nami is a premier lane duo. R provides disengage and engage. Excellent sustain and poke.

Soraka.adc_interaction_notes: Infinite sustain keeps ADC healthy through any poke or trade. Global R saves ADC from cross-map. Best with scaling ADCs who need to survive lane phase.

Milio.adc_interaction_notes: Range extension passive + cleansing R. Empowers auto-attacking ADCs with extra range and fire damage. R cleanses all CC from allies. Excellent with immobile carries.

Yuumi.adc_interaction_notes: Untargetable enchanter that attaches to ADC. Provides adaptive stats, healing, and R root. Twitch/Zeri love her. Weak lane but scales into monster. ADC must survive 2v1 moments.

Renata.adc_interaction_notes: W revive window saves ADC from lethal burst. R forces enemies to attack each other. Best when ADC will be dove — her W punishes assassin all-ins.

Karma.adc_interaction_notes: Strong poke with R-Q in lane. Shield + speed with E provides movespeed for kiting. Good lane bully but weaker scaling than pure enchanters. Best with mobile ADCs.

Lux.adc_interaction_notes: Poke and burst mage support. Q root sets up kills. Best with Caitlyn (trap + Q combo). Provides shield but is more damage-oriented than true enchanters.

Zyra.adc_interaction_notes: Zone control with plants. R provides massive AOE knockup in teamfights. Strong lane presence and damage. Caitlyn/Jhin/MF pair well for kill lane potential.

Brand.adc_interaction_notes: Pure damage support. Passive burn + R bounces provide huge teamfight damage. Steals kills from ADC but provides waveclear and pressure. Best in poke/damage heavy compositions.

Xerath.adc_interaction_notes: Artillery poke from extreme range. Lane bully with Q+W harass. Less peel than other supports. Best with Jhin (W+W chain CC) or safe ADCs who don't need babysitting.

Velkoz.adc_interaction_notes: Similar to Xerath — long range poke and burst damage. R melts frontline in teamfights. E knockup provides some peel. Low survivability if engaged on.

Pyke.adc_interaction_notes: Assassin support with execute R that shares gold. Hook + stun provides catch. Best with lane-dominant ADCs (Draven, Lucian, MF). Falls off late but gold sharing keeps ADC rich.

Swain.adc_interaction_notes: Drain tank mage. E root sets up combos. R provides sustained teamfight presence. Functions as secondary frontline. Less traditional peel but adds damage and tankiness.

Zed.adc_interaction_notes: The iconic ADC killer. W+R combo deletes squishies instantly. Untargetable during R dash. ADCs without self-peel (Jinx, KogMaw, Aphelios) are free kills.

Akali.adc_interaction_notes: Shroud makes her untargetable by ADC autos. Multiple dashes to reach backline. Sustained assassination pattern — hard to peel because she's elusive. Needs hard CC to stop.

Leblanc.adc_interaction_notes: W dash + Q + R one-shots squishy ADCs from fog. Returns to W pad making her nearly untradeable. ADCs need Zhonya's or perfect positioning.

Katarina.adc_interaction_notes: Resets on kills make teamfights a nightmare for ADCs. If she kills one person, she can chain-kill the entire backline. Hard CC counters her completely.

Fizz.adc_interaction_notes: E untargetability dodges ADC damage, R fish amplifies his burst. One-shots ADCs with a single combo. ADCs need positioning discipline or Banshee/Edge.

Talon.adc_interaction_notes: Roams bot from mid with E wall jump. Fast combo kills ADC before they can react. Strong early roams make bot lane a gank target from level 6.

Qiyana.adc_interaction_notes: R stun + terrain interaction. Can one-shot ADC with element combos. Stealth from brush element makes her approach unpredictable. River fights near dragon are especially dangerous.

Camille.adc_interaction_notes: R traps ADC in hexagon — no escape possible. E hookshot gap close is very long range. Isolation zone + true damage makes her an ADC's worst nightmare.

Irelia.adc_interaction_notes: Multiple Q dashes to dive backline. Sustain with passive + Q makes her hard to burst. ADCs need to avoid her E stun marks. Particularly dangerous with reset passive fully stacked.

Nocturne.adc_interaction_notes: R grants vision denial AND point-click dash. Completely eliminates ADC vision before diving them. Spell shield blocks one defensive ability. Terrifying for immobile ADCs.

Hecarim.adc_interaction_notes: R fear displaces entire backline. Extremely fast engage from fog. ADCs need flash or dash to survive his charge. Becomes a problem if he gets early leads.

Vi.adc_interaction_notes: R is point-click unstoppable dash that locks down ADC. Cannot be peeled. ADC must have tools to survive the follow-up (Xayah R, Ezreal E, Tristana R).

Renekton.adc_interaction_notes: E double dash into W empowered stun. Strong early/mid threat to ADC in teamfights. Falls off late but can delete ADC during his window of strength. Flash + W is undodgeable.

Maokai.adc_interaction_notes: When allied: excellent peel with W root, E vision, and R wave engage. Massive frontline that ADCs can free-hit behind. When enemy: R engage + W root can reach backline.

Ornn.adc_interaction_notes: Allied Ornn provides upgraded items that make ADC stronger. R engage is one of the best team-fight openers. Massive frontline presence. ADC thrives behind Ornn's tankiness.

Sejuani.adc_interaction_notes: Engage + peel tank. R is a massive AOE stun. Passive provides melee allies with stun procs. Good frontline for ADC. E freeze + R stun provides heavy CC layering.

Malphite.adc_interaction_notes: R is the most iconic engage in the game. When allied: ADC just needs to follow up on Malphite R. When enemy: ADC must respect R flash range at all times.

Sion.adc_interaction_notes: Massive health pool tank. R engage from distance. Q charged is a huge AOE knockup. Allied Sion provides a meat shield that ADC can DPS behind.

KSante.adc_interaction_notes: R grabs a target and walls them away. Can isolate enemy frontline away from the fight, letting ADC hit backline freely. Dual identity (tank/skirmisher) makes him versatile.
